What we do

Three disciplines, one accountable team

Most vendors hand you off at the boundary between building, testing, and supporting. We don't have that boundary — the engineers who write the code are the same team that keeps it healthy in production.

Development

Web and product engineering built on typed, tested, documented foundations — not just working demos.

  • Full-stack web applications
  • API and systems architecture
  • Legacy modernization

Quality Assurance

Manual and automated testing built to find what a rushed release would have missed.

  • Manual & exploratory testing
  • Automated regression suites
  • Performance & load testing

Technical Support

Real people on call for the moment something breaks in front of your users.

  • Tiered incident response
  • Monitoring & alerting setup
  • Customer-facing help desks
How we work

A lifecycle, not a handoff

Every engagement moves through the same four stages, with the same people accountable end to end.

01

Scope & architecture

We map the system before writing a line of code — data flows, integrations, failure points, and what "done" actually means.

02

Build in the open

Short cycles, visible progress, and code that's reviewed and documented as it's written — not cleaned up after the fact.

03

Break it on purpose

QA runs alongside development, not after it, so defects surface while they're still cheap to fix.

04

Stay on call

Launch isn't the finish line. Our support desk knows the system because we're the ones who built it.
